name: Analytic Moment Voxelization
aliases: GPU Polyhedral Voxelization with Analytic Moments
definition: A GPU-based technique to voxelize a 3D polyhedron by computing analytic moments of a polynomial density field over its volume, using geometric clipping and simplicial decomposition.
summary: Analytic Moment Voxelization is a GPU technique that converts 3D polyhedra into voxel grids by computing exact polynomial moment integrals via geometric clipping, ensuring deterministic results for arbitrary convex shapes.
